project_specification.project_name: nullius — campaign driver (orchestrator member, spec B)

existing_context.stack: Python 3.12 / uv-workspace / SQLite or PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL / pytest (ruff conventions)
existing_context.test_baseline: Measured 2026-10-06 on main (HEAD 33af1fa): workspace tests/ 1614 passed; orchestrator 133 (pre-OCI-2), signal-agent 761, discovery 678, policy-runtime green.
existing_context.conventions:
Follow CLAUDE.md: members only; @register only in __init__.py; components via create_app().get(name); typed refusals with a code word in the raising module; and no network or credential in tests.
Existing pieces (read, do not edit unless a feature names the file): - orchestrator (spec A): - LiveEvaluator.evaluate(node_id, campaign_id, depth, code) -> NodeEvaluation(node_id, metrics, score, charges_budget, fail_class, persistence, debit). - load_evaluation_context(env) -> EvaluationContext, which carries the provenance trio, epoch_id, database_url and artifact_dir. - The "live-evaluator" component. - signal_agent (llm_authoring): - LLMSignalAuthor(workspace) -> AuthoredSignal(code, stated_mechanism, proposal, record), which expands an existing node. record is a providers.AuthoringRecord with attempt_provenance_terms(). - The "signal-author" component, and ProposalHistoryStore.persist( node_id, proposal, *, score=None). - providers: record_authoring(record, *, database_url) and record_campaign_cache_rate(campaign_id, records, *, database_url). - discovery: - create_campaign(campaign_type, workspace_count, *, database_url) -> CampaignRecord. - assign_theme(...) and legal_themes_from_env(env). - NodeExpansion(agent, database_url)(node_id) -> RefinedSignal. - persist.Attempt.from_signal(signal, provenance, *, fail_class, ...), which refuses depth 0. AttemptLog(database_url, directory).record(attempt). AttemptProvenance(evaluator_hash, snapshot_hash, cost_model_hash, agent_model_id, agent_sampling, agent_ckpt_hash). - workers.run_batch(worker, jobs, *, width) and retry.retry_interrupted(worker, results, *, retries, width), where WorkerInterrupted is retryable and every other error is final. - manifest.finish_campaign(campaign_id, *, database_url). - Feature 242: a campaign ends when the policy selects no batch. - nulloracle: TypeRSelection(database_url, sidecar).persist(campaign_id) seals the campaign's roots. It reads phi and W from the campaign row, so it must run after the roots are planted and before any evaluation. The component is "nulloracle-type-r-selection". - policy_runtime: - CampaignTree.freeze({node_id: (parent_id, depth, payload)}) and PolicyQuestion(tree, budget). PolicyQuestion offers reveal_many, observed, legal_roots and legal_actions. - prefix_view(question) -> PrefixView, whose cells are PolicyObservation(node_id, r2_insample, ic_insample, n_periods, n_features), read from the node payload. - budget_account(allowance, rows) -> BudgetAccount (.remaining, .exhausted). - screen_policy(source) -> PolicyAdmissionDecision, guard_policy(policy_module=POLICY_MODULE_NAME, ...) and POLICY_MODULE_NAME. - The policy contract is policy.select(prefix_view) -> a batch of node ids, as replay calls it. - The node table carries id, parent_id, campaign_id, theme_root, depth and the 0114 to 0117 columns (metrics, agent trio, provenance trio, code_hash, artifact_uri, stated_mechanism). The artifacts member's ArtifactStore stores code. CLI modules follow the providers.live_check pattern: main(argv=None, *, env=None, ...) -> int.

category.name: Roots
category.feature: System creates a campaign's opening signal with LLMSignalAuthor.author_root(campaign_id, theme_root, *, root_id), which answers an AuthoredSignal whose record has depth 0 and role root. - The root id is the caller's root_id (a UUID). The model is chosen with session.provider_for("root", campaign_id, node_id=root_id), so the root rotation decides it. - The prompt is signal_agent's build_authoring_prompt (the C3 prompt of additions_spec_llm_authoring.xml) for depth 0 in theme_root, with the campaign's history, which is empty for the first root. - The answer goes through the same parse, adopt, anti-convergence and retry path as an expansion. Refusals are unchanged (AuthoringRefusedError, BudgetExhaustedError and ServedModelMismatchError). - The existing __call__(workspace) is unchanged, and its tests stay green.

System persists a planted root as a depth-0 node row with orchestrator._roots.plant_root(campaign_id, theme_root, authored, *, context, artifact_store), and it answers the root's node id. - The row is id = authored.record.node_id, parent_id NULL, depth 0, campaign_id and theme_root. - code_hash is the signal_agent source_code_hash of authored.code, and artifact_uri is where the code is written through the ArtifactStore. stated_mechanism is authored.stated_mechanism. - agent_model_id and agent_sampling come from authored.record.attempt_provenance_terms(). The provenance trio comes from context. - Planting the same root twice with identical values answers the same id and writes nothing. Different values for an existing id raise RootPlantError (code word root_plant). - An authored record whose depth is not 0 raises RootPlantError. - Tests use a migrated throwaway SQLite database. - This feature claims packages/orchestrator/pyproject.toml so that no other feature touches it, and it leaves the file unchanged: spec A already declared every workspace dependency the driver needs.

category.name: Exploration Policy
category.feature: System creates a live policy question over a running campaign with orchestrator._live_tree.live_question(campaign_id, *, database_url, evaluation_periods, budget=None). It answers a policy_runtime.PolicyQuestion over a CampaignTree frozen from the campaign's node rows. - Every evaluated node is revealed. - Each node's payload is {ic_insample: ic_mean, r2_insample: ic_mean squared, n_periods: evaluation_periods, n_features: 1}. A node with no metrics, because it failed or is not yet evaluated, has a payload of None and is not revealed. - The tree is rebuilt from the rows on every call, so a new child is visible in the next round. - The module reads only the node table's id, parent_id, depth and metric columns. It never reads the null sidecar, and never reads a null bit.

System creates the exploration policy that selects the next batch of nodes to expand, with orchestrator._policy.load_exploration_policy(env=None). The policy's select(prefix_view) answers a list of node ids. - When NULLIUS_EXPLORATION_POLICY names a source file, its text must be admitted by policy_runtime.screen_policy. A refusal raises PolicyLoadError (code word policy_load) carrying the decision's reason. An admitted file is imported as POLICY_MODULE_NAME under guard_policy, and its top-level select function is the policy. - When the variable is unset, the policy is BaselinePolicy(width). It answers up to width revealed node ids, highest ic_insample first, at most one per theme root per batch, with ties broken by node id. A view with no revealed node answers []. - The answer is checked: ids not in the view, duplicates, or a non-list raise PolicyLoadError.

category.name: Campaign Loop
category.feature: System expands and evaluates one parent node with orchestrator._worker.NodeWorker(author, evaluator, *, context, artifact_directory, history_store), and it creates the child's ChildOutcome(node_id, depth, fail_class, score, charges_budget, record). - NodeWorker(parent_id) runs discovery.NodeExpansion(author, database_url)(parent_id), and builds Attempt.from_signal with AttemptProvenance from context and the author's record.attempt_provenance_terms(). It records the attempt with AttemptLog, then calls providers.record_authoring(record). - It then calls evaluator.evaluate(child id, campaign_id, depth, code), and persists the proposal and its score with history_store.persist(child id, proposal, score=evaluation.score). - An AuthoringRefusedError is recorded as a failed attempt, with fail_class authoring_refused, and is not evaluated. BudgetExhaustedError propagates and stops the campaign. WorkerInterrupted propagates for retry_interrupted. - Running the same parent twice is idempotent: the child's uuid5 id, the ledger's per-node debit and the stores' conflict rules answer the first outcome. - Tests use fake author and evaluator objects.

System runs one campaign with orchestrator._campaign.run_campaign(*, campaign_type, workspaces, rounds, width, allowance, author, evaluator, policy, context, sidecar_selection, emit), and it creates a CampaignResult(campaign_id, roots, nodes, rounds_run, stop_reason, manifest). - Plant: create_campaign(campaign_type, workspaces). Then for each of the workspaces roots: assign_theme, author.author_root, plant_root, record_authoring, and proposal persistence. - Seal: after all roots are planted and before any evaluation, sidecar_selection.persist(campaign_id). - Evaluate every root with evaluator.evaluate, and persist each root's score. - Loop for up to rounds rounds: - Build live_question with budget_account(allowance, ledger rows). - batch = policy.select(prefix_view(question))[:width]. - Run the batch with run_batch(NodeWorker, batch, width=width) wrapped in retry_interrupted(retries=2). - Stop on the first of these. stop_reason is the matching word: - the policy answers an empty batch (no_batch, feature 242); - the budget is exhausted (budget_exhausted); - a BudgetExhaustedError from the token budget (token_budget); - the round cap (round_cap). - Finish: finish_campaign(campaign_id), and record_campaign_cache_rate(campaign_id, records) when any depth record exists. - emit receives one JSON-ready dict per planted root, per evaluated node and per round, plus a final summary. - The function never reads a null bit. Tests drive it with fakes and a migrated SQLite database.

System runs a campaign from `python -m orchestrator.campaign --type TYPE --workspaces W --rounds R [--width N] [--allowance UNITS]` and prints one JSON line per emitted event, followed by the summary line. - The command takes the "signal-author", "live-evaluator" and "nulloracle-type-r-selection" components from create_app(), and loads the policy with load_exploration_policy. - It refuses to start with exit 2 and one stderr line naming the missing piece when a component answers None, meaning an unconfigured author or evaluator. - Exit codes: 0 when the campaign finished (any stop_reason), 1 on a refusal raised mid-campaign (its code word on stderr), 2 on bad arguments or missing configuration. - main(argv=None, *, env=None, app=None, emit=print) is injectable. No API key or credential is ever printed.

category.name: Campaign Verification
category.feature: System verifies a small live campaign end to end with no network in tests/e2e/test_live_campaign_end_to_end.py. - Setup: W=2 roots and 2 rounds of width 2, a seeded snapshot, a throwaway sidecar and SQLite database, and an LLMSignalAuthor whose session answers RecordedProvider fixtures. The fixtures are valid signal sources with Mechanism lines. - It uses the real live evaluator, and the baseline policy. - The test asserts that both roots are depth-0 rows with code_hash, agent and provenance columns, and that the roots were sealed before the first evaluation. - It asserts that every node row has metrics or a fail_class, and that the ledger holds exactly one debit per node with the oracle's charges_budget. - It asserts that each node's proposal and score are persisted, that the manifest is finished, and that stop_reason is round_cap or no_batch. - A second run with a policy that answers [] at once stops with no_batch after the roots.

project_specification.integration_points: New modules in packages/orchestrator: _roots, _live_tree, _policy, _worker and _campaign, plus the runnable orchestrator.campaign. signal_agent._llm_author gains author_root (feature 1). No new component is registered: the command composes the existing components. Every new file is committed as an empty stub so its claim resolves. Wiring the command into run.sh, with its 1Password template for the NULLIUS_*_API_KEY variables, is an operator step and outside this spec.
project_specification.constraints: - No orchestrator module reads a node's null status, the sidecar key or an is_null value. Only nulloracle's own TypeRSelection.persist touches the sidecar. - Every evaluated node, failed ones included, is debited once. Authoring refusals are recorded as failed attempts. - Do not edit the evaluator, nulloracle, ledger, artifacts, discovery, policy-runtime or providers members, the migrations, or the root pyproject.toml. - No test opens a network connection or reads a real credential. No third-party dependency is added. - Do not edit run.sh, the .env templates, claw-forge.yaml or docs/user-journeys/. - All existing workspace tests and the member suites of orchestrator, signal-agent, discovery and policy-runtime stay green.

implementation_steps.step: Phase 1: author_root (feature 1), the root planter (feature 2), the live tree (feature 3) and the worker (feature 5), in parallel.
Phase 2: the policy loader with the baseline (feature 4).
Phase 4: the command (feature 7) and the end-to-end verification (feature 8).
